info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Product Management Product Quality Assurances-spec
info.description: The Product Quality Assurance Retrieval API allows users to access and review the quality assurance records associated with various products under the product management umbrella. This endpoint serves as a vital tool for stakeholders aiming to ensure compliance and maintain the high standards of quality demanded by both regulatory bodies and customers. Typical consumers include product managers, quality assurance teams, and compliance officers who require easy access to detailed quality assurance data for reporting and analysis. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their product reliability and customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information regarding the quality assurance processes for products. It provides insights into various quality metrics, standards followed, and compliance checks that ensure the integrity of product quality.
